name: EPIC 206036741
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 5.8 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206036741 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.819257 (16th-84th percentiles 5.635713-6.011763), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,556 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.17 solar masses and 5.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,934 K at its surface.
